ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Nonprofit Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme, and identify potential vulnerabilities in the system.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What are the common characteristics of nonprofit fraud schemes?
How can the state of Minnesota improve its oversight of nonprofits?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and to identify systemic vulnerabilities that can be addressed through policy changes. By analyzing data and reviewing public records, we can gain a deeper understanding of the scope of the problem and identify potential solutions.
